settings.title: Settings

general.title: General
general.themeDesc: Change the look and feel of the application.
general.xmpSyncDesc: Sync ratings, color labels and tags to standard XMP sidecar files for compatibility with other photo editors.
general.createXmpFilesDesc: Automatically create a new XMP sidecar file if one does not exist for an image.
general.folderImageCountsDesc: Show the number of images inside folders when hovering over the folder tree.
general.focusModeDesc: Helps you focus by automatically closing other panels when you open a new one.
general.nativeTitlebarDesc: Use your system's default window titlebar instead of RapidRAW's custom one.

settings.adjustmentsVisibilityDesc: Hide adjustment sections you don't use often to simplify the editing panel. Your settings will be preserved and applied even when hidden.
settings.myLensesDesc: Create a list of your frequently used lenses to quickly access them in the Lens Correction panel.
settings.aiTaggingDesc: Enables automatic image tagging using an AI (CLIP) model. This will download an additional model and impact performance while browsing folders. Tags are used for searching a folder.
settings.maxAiTagsDesc: The maximum number of tags to generate per image.
settings.customAiTagListDesc: If provided, the AI will ONLY use tags from this list, overriding RapidRAW's built-in list. Tagging works only in English.
settings.noCustomAiTags: No custom AI tags (Using built-in list)
settings.taggingShortcutsDesc: A list of tags that will appear as shortcuts in the tagging context menu.
settings.clearAiTagsDesc: This will remove all AI-generated tags from your .rrdata files in all active root folders. User-added tags will be kept.
settings.clearAllTagsDesc: This will remove all AI-generated and user-added tags from your .rrdata files in all active root folders. Color labels will be kept.
settings.specialThanksDesc: A huge thank you to the following projects that were very important in the development of RapidRAW:

processing.title: Processing
processing.staticPreviewDesc: The editor renders the image at a fixed resolution. This mode is the fastest and most consistent, making it ideal for lower-end hardware where smooth performance is prioritized over pixel-perfect zoom.
processing.previewResolutionDesc: Determines the maximum resolution of the preview. Lower values significantly improve performance.
processing.dynamicPreviewDesc: The editor renders the preview to match your display's actual pixel density. This ensures that every detail is represented with 1:1 pixel accuracy, providing maximum clarity when zooming and checking focus.
processing.staticPreviewResolutionDesc: Sets the resolution for static previews like crop mode, lens correction, and perspective tools. Does not affect the main editor preview.
processing.renderResolutionScaleDesc: Scales the render resolution relative to your display. Lower values improve performance on high-resolution screens at the cost of some sharpness.
processing.highDpiDesc: Render previews at your screen's native {{dpr}}x physical pixel resolution. Produces the sharpest possible preview but uses significantly more memory.
processing.standardDpiDesc: This setting only affects high-DPI displays. Your current display is standard resolution.
processing.liveInteractivePreviewsDesc: Update the preview immediately while dragging sliders. Disable this if the interface feels laggy during adjustments.
processing.livePreviewQualityDesc: Controls the resolution and compression of the image while dragging sliders. Lower quality significantly improves responsiveness.
processing.thumbnailResolutionDesc2: Determines the resolution of generated library thumbnails. Higher values produce sharper images during loading.
processing.thumbnailWorkerThreadsDesc: Number of parallel threads used to generate thumbnails. Higher values speed up library loading but use more CPU & RAM.
processing.decodedImageCacheDesc: Maximum number of full-resolution images kept in RAM. Higher values make switching between recently edited images instant, but use significantly more memory.
processing.wgpuLinuxDesc: Bypasses browser encoding for instantly responsive live previews. (Disabled on Linux: Tauri uses GTK for webviews, which conflicts with WGPU on the same X11 surface and causes flickering.)
processing.wgpuAndroidDesc: Bypasses browser encoding for instantly responsive live previews. (Disabled on Android: Native WGPU surface creation is currently not supported alongside the mobile webview.)
processing.wgpuRecommendedDesc: Bypasses browser encoding for instantly responsive live previews. Highly recommended for performance.
processing.processingBackendDesc: Select the graphics API. 'Auto' is recommended. May fix crashes on some systems.
processing.linuxCompatibilityModeDesc: Enable workarounds for common GPU driver and display server issues. Disable this to enable full GPU acceleration.
processing.restartRequiredDesc: Changes to the processing engine require an application restart to take effect.
processing.rawHighlightRecoveryDesc: Controls how much detail is recovered from clipped highlights in RAW files. Higher values recover more detail but can introduce purple artefacts.
processing.baseColorNoiseReductionDesc: Applies a cross-bilateral filter early in the pipeline to remove chroma noise. Higher value = Stronger NR.
processing.preSharpeningDesc: Applies gentle detail enhancement early in the pipeline. Higher value = More sharpening.
processing.applyPreprocessingToNonRawsDesc: If enabled, the base color noise reduction and pre-sharpening above will also be applied to standard formats.
processing.linearRawProcessingDesc: Fixes color casts or pink tint in some DNG files. Controls how already processed LinearRAW data is interpreted.
processing.globalTonemapperOverrideDesc: Force a specific tonemapper globally for all images, hiding the tonemapper switch from the adjustments panel.
processing.defaultRawTonemapperDesc: The tonemapper to apply to RAW images.
processing.defaultNonRawTonemapperDesc: The tonemapper to apply to non-RAW images (e.g., JPEG, PNG).

settings.generativeAiDesc: RapidRAW's AI is built for flexibility. Choose your ideal workflow, from fast local tools to powerful self-hosting.
settings.builtinAiCpuDesc: Integrated directly into RapidRAW, these features run entirely on your computer. They are fast, free, and require no setup, making them ideal for everyday workflow acceleration.
settings.selfHostedConnectorDesc: For users with a capable GPU who want maximum control, connect RapidRAW to your own Connector server. This gives you full control for technical workflows.
settings.aiConnectorAddressDesc: Enter the address and port of your running AI Connector instance. Required for generative AI features.
settings.cloudServiceDesc: For those who want a simpler solution, an optional subscription provides the same high-quality results as self-hosting without any hassle. This is the most convenient option and the best way to support the project.
settings.clearAllSidecarFilesDescPart2: files (containing your edits) within your root folders:
settings.clearThumbnailCacheDesc: This will delete all cached thumbnail images. They will be regenerated automatically as you browse your library.
settings.viewApplicationLogsDesc: View the application's log file for troubleshooting. The log is located at:
settings.inputDeviceOptimizationDesc: Choose the primary input device you use to pan and zoom the canvas.
settings.zoomSpeedMultiplierDesc: Adjust how fast the canvas zooms in and out when using the scroll wheel or pinch gesture.
settings.confirmDeleteSidecarsDesc: Are you sure you want to delete all sidecar files?\n\nThis will permanently remove all your edits for all images inside all active root folders and their subfolders.
settings.clearingAiTags: Clearing AI tags from all sidecar files...
settings.confirmClearAiTagsDesc: Are you sure you want to remove all AI-generated tags from all images in all active root folders?\n\nThis will not affect user-added tags. This action cannot be undone.
settings.clearingAllTags: Clearing all tags from sidecar files...
settings.allTagsCleared: {{count}} files updated. All non-color tags removed.
settings.confirmClearAllTagsDesc: Are you sure you want to remove all AI-generated and user-added tags from all images in all active root folders?\n\nThis action cannot be undone.
settings.confirmClearCacheDesc: Are you sure you want to clear the thumbnail cache?\n\nAll thumbnails will need to be regenerated, which may be slow for large folders.
